insight: Scores traces with its own small 'Luna' evaluation models rather than an LLM-as-judge, keeping inline production guardrails cheap to run.
name: Galileo
tagline: Evaluation and observability for GenAI apps and agents, with inline guardrails.
description: A platform for testing, monitoring, and guardrailing LLM and agent applications. It ships 20+ out-of-the-box evals for RAG, agents, and safety, lets teams author custom evaluators, and turns those offline evals into real-time production guardrails powered by its own Luna eval models.
